passage:
Students made a noise map of their neighborhood. They measured sound levels near roads, parks, schools, and construction sites.
The loudest place was not the main road, as expected, but a narrow street where scooters echoed between tall buildings.
The class shared the map with local officials. They suggested better traffic signs and quiet zones near the clinic.
The project made students notice sound as part of city life. Noise was not only annoying; it affected rest, concentration, and health.
A city is often planned by what people can see. The noise map showed that what people hear also needs planning.
